slides.title: A correct OTP proves possession, not presence
slides.message: Phishing relay, SIM swap and session hijack all arrive with valid credentials. Password + OTP stopped 0 of 367 takeovers.

slides.title: Static rules challenge the wrong people
slides.message: Rules caught 76.6% of takeovers but interrupted 98.6% of travellers and 28.6% of all genuine sessions.

slides.title: Keep asking after sign-in
slides.message: Login, payee and every transfer are scored; the backend enforces ALLOW, STEP-UP or BLOCK; step-up goes to a separate trusted device.

media.diagram: four-step decision loop with three outcomes

slides.title: Normal is personal
slides.message: 15 deviations from this customer's own baseline, one shared Isolation Forest, written policy points, four explanation panels.

slides.title: It learns without being poisoned
slides.message: New behaviour waits in a candidate profile until the customer verifies it, then two clean sessions and 24 hours. Every change can be rolled back.

slides.title: More caught, far fewer bothered
slides.message: 91.3% recall at 5.2% genuine interruption, against 76.6% at 28.6% for static rules.

slides.title: Where it doesn't win
slides.message: It saves about the same money as static rules, blocks more genuine money outright, and catches 58.6% of familiar-device hijacks.

slides.title: A block is where the analyst's work starts
slides.message: SecureSynth 3.0 follows the incident: contain, collect evidence, investigate, report, recover.

slides.title: Evidence you can check
slides.message: Encrypted files, a SHA-256 hash chain, tamper alerts that never auto-repair. Tamper-evident, not immutable.

slides.title: Leads, not proof
slides.message: Incidents linked by shared IP, device or payee, each link graded and explained. Nothing acts on its own.

slides.title: Live: a takeover with the right password and OTP
slides.message: Judge mode runs the attack through the real API. Blocked at 99.1; the protected balance doesn't move.

slides.title: Built to be checked
slides.message: 165 tests, 5.61 ms p95 decisions, a frozen SHA-256 manifest, fully offline.

slides.title: Not production yet, and here's the gap
slides.message: Real consented data, a real trusted-device app, payee-risk signals, production infrastructure, external ledger anchoring.

slides.title: Possession isn't presence
slides.message: SecureSynth keeps checking, explains itself, and asks the real customer when it's unsure.
